title: Verify environment-specific path mappings before acting on task specs
body: Task specs may reference paths (e.g., /opt/salesman-api/) that map to different locations on the actual machine (e.g., /Users/miguelrodriguez/projects/salesman-cloud-infra/). Confirm the mapping before creating directories or running scripts.
